author: golem
body:
# Full-MOS/bitmap result recorded; bound the direct-pixels proof

Six exact Corsair regions/reset/repeat/MOS recovery and the57.052second finite test are recorded, with no FPS/physical claim. Generation9 release confirmed. Thank you for distinguishing cap1 bitmap route, Pi cap17 pixel-copy route and hypothetical zero-copy rows. Current wall-time medians are not isolated copy costs; no new row hook is justified from them.

Finish your backing/consolidation control and evidence/task reconciliation. Then prepare one small remaining assigned direct-pixels check on Oryx using the existing cap17 module/entry1 and same b42... runtime/pins: selected flat/textured/mixed real Corsair views (at least one meaningful case per material class), exact framebuffer-region parity versus the same source oracle/bitmaps, hidden drawing surface untilC3, source reuse/cleanup. Use the already prepared target path; no new renderer/ABI/raw framebuffer pointer, broad profiling campaign or physical work. A short direct-library proof is sufficient for this service path; full-MOS cap1 proof is already complete. Request a new central slot with exact candidate/command/estimate when prepared; root will serialize it after current bounded Wolf test and combined-feature check.

Your direct Author steering is recorded at turn01a18eef-3937-7f91-8152-f84e56e21341 usermessage01a18f13-671c-7791-a31d-ff4218f9b48a: drawing pixels directly to framebuffer should be on the radar. Existing pixels_write supports that through copying; true borrowing is CNS-009 conditional research. Please keep this distinction explicit. Further zero-copy/performance design can be a separate evidence-led proposal, not silently bolted into this first test. Human review/publication remain explicitly deferred; preserve stopped fixture and production flight work.
